title: Fix UPI payment option missing in desktop Razorpay checkout

requirements.summary: Update Razorpay checkout configuration to include UPI payment method on desktop
acceptanceCriteria: The UPI payment option is visible in the Razorpay checkout modal when accessed from a desktop browser.
The UPI payment option continues to be visible in the Razorpay checkout modal when accessed from a mobile browser.
No other existing payment methods (cards, net banking, wallets, etc.) are removed from the desktop or mobile checkout configuration.
The fix is applied in `frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpay.ts` within the device-aware payment method configuration logic.
The `isMobileDevice()` utility in `frontend/src/utils/deviceDetection.ts` is not broken or changed in a way that affects other features.

file_operations.description: Update the Razorpay checkout options configuration in the `openRazorpayCheckout` function to include UPI in the `config.method` array for both mobile and desktop devices. Currently, the code conditionally excludes UPI from desktop by using device detection logic. Modify the payment method configuration so that UPI ('upi') is present in the method array regardless of whether `isMobileDevice()` returns true or false. Ensure all other payment methods (card, netbanking, wallet, etc.) remain unchanged and continue to work on both mobile and desktop. Do not alter the Razorpay options structure or callback handlers beyond fixing the payment method list.
